_comment: The exact verified TURBO text-to-image graph for Z-Image-Turbo (Tongyi-MAI, 6B S3-DiT, apache-2.0) on a free T4, using the Comfy-Org split files and the official t2i template recipe verbatim: CLIPLoader type=lumina2 for the Qwen3-4B text encoder (there is no z_image type), ModelSamplingAuraFlow shift=3, KSampler 8 steps cfg 1.0 res_multistep/simple, ConditioningZeroOut negative. POST to /prompt wrapped as {"prompt": <this object>, "client_id": "x"}. Settings = the measured combo: 768x768, seed 42 -> ~18 s warm repeat (fastest measured on a free T4), ~42 s on the first render with a fresh prompt (the 8.04 GB text encoder cannot stay resident beside the 12.31 GB unet on 15.6 GB, so ComfyUI reloads it per new prompt — see references/04-tweaking.md). The distill_patch_lora in the Comfy-Org repo is NOT needed for t2i. Numbers trace to timings_v7_zimage.json + timings_v7b_warm.json in the GPUTests lab repo (projects/2026-W40-zimage-turbo-t4/). The Qwen turbo comparison graph: workflows/t2i-qwen-turbo.json.
